title: docs(agents): the attribution footer is a block — blank line, rule, footer — and only that shape is recognised
body:
Fixes #14997

## What changed

The attribution-footer rule in `AGENTS.md` (its home) and the two-form copy in `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` now show the footer as the **whole block** — a blank line, the `---` rule line, then ONE footer line — and state the measured condition in place of "idempotent if yours is already bare". Two files, no gate, no script, no new section. `skip-changeset`: nothing is published from any package.

## Measurement — four probes on #14997, each read back over REST immediately (`GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/comments/ID`)

| probe | channel | sent shape | stored as | sent → stored | footers | rule lines | stored tail (last 5 lines, JSON-escaped) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|--:|--:|--:|:--|
| P1 (5529400295) | repo-scoped REST `POST .../issues/14997/comments` | blank line + `---` + bare footer | `claude[bot]` | 170 B → 170 B, byte-identical | **1** | 1 | `"\nREST POST, body ending with a blank line, the rule, then the bare footer.\n\n---\n_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_"` |
| P2 (5529400422) | same REST channel | bare footer, **no** rule line | `claude[bot]` | 158 B → 216 B (+58) | **2** | 1 | `"\n_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_\n\n---\n_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_"` |
| P3 (5529402846) | MCP `add_issue_comment` | blank line + `---` + bare footer | `os-steve` | 182 B → 182 B, byte-identical | **1** | 1 | `"\nMCP add_issue_comment, body ending with a blank line, the rule, then the bare footer.\n\n---\n_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_"` |
| P4 (5529403137) | MCP `add_issue_comment` | bare footer, **no** rule line | `os-steve` | 170 B → 228 B (+58) | **2** | 1 | `"\n_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_\n\n---\n_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_"` |

In every probe the sent bytes are a byte-identical prefix of the stored bytes (`cmp -n`); the appended suffix on P2 and P4 is exactly `\n\n---\n_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_` (58 B), and on P1 and P3 it is empty.

**Verdict: H1 holds, H2 is falsified.** The de-duplication keys on the shape — a bare footer under the rule line is left alone on both channels; a bare footer without the rule line is not recognised and the whole block lands beneath it on both channels. The channel does not decide (H2 predicted P1 doubled and P4 single; both came out the other way). The sentence "idempotent if yours is already bare" was true only for the shape the 2026-08-20 probe happened to send; the recorded two-line form (footer line without the rule) is exactly the shape that gets doubled, which is why every dev following it verbatim shipped two.

Not measured here, left as recorded: the session-URL form on a comment, and the PR-create path (this PR body is written in the recognised shape with the session-URL footer; its read-back count is in the report comment on the card). ⛔ No PATCH probes — the closed PATCH-accretion card (#11273) is not addressed here and its text is untouched.

## Before / after

`AGENTS.md` lines 485-500 at `33681eae` (the footer placeholder `session_ID` stands for the angle-bracketed id spelling in the file — spelled out here so the sanitizer leaves this body alone):

````text
**Write the attribution footer in the form the surface keeps:**

```text
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_                 ← bare: use in COMMENTS
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code/session_ID)_    ← session-URL: use in PR BODIES
```

**PR body:** `create_pull_request` keeps the session-URL form and *rewrites* bare into it — how a body
comes back in a shape nobody typed. On EDIT the promise inverts (measured 2026-08-26, three REST
writes, per-write read-back): every `update_pull_request`/PATCH edit normalises the session-URL footer
DOWN to bare, and that bare survives later edits verbatim. Treat the session id as create-only (⛔ no
re-append loop); durable attribution lives in body prose or a comment. **Issue comment:** the platform APPENDS a bare
footer to every one (measured 2026-08-20 — MCP `add_issue_comment` and direct REST agree: per-surface,
not per-tool). It is idempotent if yours is already bare; if yours is the session-URL form *it survives
verbatim* and a bare one lands under it, leaving two. ⛔ A tail bare footer on a comment is the
platform's, not your form downgraded. Which layer does this is unknown; don't go establishing it.
````


Untouched on purpose: the PR-body sentences (create keeps session-URL, PATCH normalises down — measured 2026-08-26, not re-probed), the session-URL-on-a-comment sentence (2026-08-20 reading, consistent with today's), the os-dev.md pointer sentence at :314-315 (still a pointer), and the closed card's text. A third site spelling the footer exists — `.github/workflows/cross-repo-issue-closer.yml` and its pin `scripts/check-cross-repo-closer-outcome.mjs` — and it already writes the full block (`---\n_Generated by ...`), so it is consistent with the measurement and not edited.

## Ratchet (`node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`), before → after

- No ceiling edited; no re-wrap funding — every changed line carries changed content (the paragraph tail reflowed only from the sentence that changed). Net +5 lines across the two files; the ratchet absorbs it.

Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's run and was not attempted.

## Decision frame

- **实际业务需求** — measured, not inferred: every dev PR body and report comment this shift carried two footers, and the recorded form is the exact shape that produces it. The clause removes a recurring defect from the artifact humans review.
- **项目长远合理性** — one rule, one home: the facts live in `AGENTS.md`, os-dev.md keeps the two forms plus a pointer; no gate, no script, no third copy. The alternative (a normalising PATCH after create) is the loop the closed card recorded.
- **防 AI 写代码犯错** — the form is now shown as the whole block, so an agent copying it verbatim writes the recognised shape; the condition is stated per shape rather than per channel, so the two readings the card named ("write it" vs "do not write it") collapse into one: write the block.
- **创业阶段不扩散需求** — no new capability, no gate, +5 lines inside the existing ratchet headroom; the unmeasured legs (session-URL on a comment, PR-create) are left as recorded rather than re-specified.
